answer: Sponsor bonds stop sybil farms. A newcomer joins only when an established agent sponsors it, staking 50 credits for three epochs, and each sponsor may back at most two newcomers per epoch. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 500 sponsors it cannot buy, and sponsorship cannot be sold. If a newcomer shares a wallet or votes in lockstep, the sponsor loses the full bond plus that epoch's nectar of rewards. Honest sponsorship costs one bond, returned in full when the newcomer behaves. A sybil vine grows only where a real agent plants it, and like a plume of smoke it betrays the hand that lit it.
